decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of lodgepole and shore pine: needles in bundles of two, 3 to 7 cm long, twisted, about 1.5 mm wide, orange-brown when shed; cones 3 to 6 cm, egg-shaped and often lopsided. Pine needles rot slowly. Colours chosen by eye; cone numbers plausible, not measured.

look.note: Authored: the drawn look's mean hue at the brightness chosen by eye for this species' litter, the relief the drawing has, and a tile its pieces repeat on unseen. PlantGen's litter tests check the hue and relief against the drawing.
